//==
// # Rigid bodies

// A planar rigid body. LinearVelocity is in meters per second; LinearDamping
// and AngularDamping are exponential velocity decay rates in units of one per
// second (0 = none); GravityScale is a dimensionless multiplier on world
// gravity (1 = normal, 0 = unaffected).
type RigidBody2D
    implements IValue
{
    Pose: Pose2D;
    LinearVelocity: Vector2D;
    AngularVelocity: AngularVelocity;
    MassProperties: MassProperties2D;
    Motion: BodyMotion;
    LinearDamping: Number;
    AngularDamping: Number;
    GravityScale: Number;
}
